institution_name: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi
programme_name: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering

peos.title: Core Technical Competence
peos.description: Graduates will have successful careers in software engineering, computing systems, and research, applying foundational CS knowledge to build robust computational solutions.

peos.title: Innovation & Higher Studies
peos.description: Graduates will adapt to emerging technologies, pursue higher education, and engage in innovative research addressing technological challenges.

peos.title: Professional Ethics & Social Responsibility
peos.description: Graduates will demonstrate professional ethics, societal responsibility, environmental sustainability, and effective multidisciplinary collaboration.

peos.title: Leadership & Continuous Learning
peos.description: Graduates will lead technical initiatives and practice self-directed life-long learning to remain agile in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

pos.title: Engineering Knowledge
pos.description: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and computer science specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

pos.title: Problem Analysis
pos.description: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex computer engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles.

pos.title: Design/Development of Solutions
pos.description: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety.

pos.title: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems
pos.description: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of information to provide valid conclusions.

pos.title: Modern Tool Usage
pos.description: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.

pos.title: The Engineer and Society
pos.description: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.

pos.title: Environment and Sustainability
pos.description: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.

pos.title: Ethics
pos.description: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.

pos.title: Individual and Team Work
pos.description: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.

pos.title: Communication
pos.description: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation.

pos.title: Project Management and Finance
pos.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

pos.title: Life-long Learning
pos.description: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

psos.title: Systems and Software Engineering
psos.description: Ability to design, build, and optimize scalable software systems, operating systems, and distributed platforms using modern software engineering practices.

psos.title: Data and Algorithmic Intelligence
psos.description: Ability to design algorithms and data pipelines to solve complex computational problems using machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data analytics.
